tokens.name: fundo
tokens.usage: Page background. Cream paper in light, near-black brown in dark.

tokens.name: fundo-elevado
tokens.usage: Cards, sticky header, open menus.

tokens.name: fundo-afundado
tokens.usage: Alternating section bands, footer, calm highlight areas.

tokens.name: texto
tokens.usage: Main text. Soft brown instead of near-black (10:1 on light, 13:1 on dark).

tokens.name: texto-suave
tokens.usage: Captions, dates, metadata (≥4.6:1 on every background).

tokens.name: linha
tokens.usage: Thin dividers and card borders. Decorative: not a control border.

tokens.name: linha-forte
tokens.usage: Border of fields and outlined buttons (3:1 against the background).

tokens.name: marrom
tokens.usage: Logo colour. Only on the logo and large identity blocks (footer, cover). Not for buttons: that is what `acao` is for.

tokens.name: acao
tokens.usage: Primary button: a medium brown, lighter than the logo's (text 6.2:1 / 7.3:1).

tokens.name: sobre-acao
tokens.usage: Text and icon on `acao`.

tokens.name: creme
tokens.usage: Cream of the logo's windows. Text and icons on brown (13:1 / 7.8:1).

tokens.name: sobre-marrom
tokens.usage: Alias: everything that sits on a brown fill.

tokens.name: mariano
tokens.usage: Our Lady's blue, more greyish. Links, focus, active tab, Marian feasts (5.6:1 / 8.9:1).

tokens.name: sobre-mariano
tokens.usage: Text on a Marian fill.

tokens.name: mariano-suave
tokens.usage: Background of Marian highlights and of 'today'; text on it is Marian (5.2:1).

tokens.name: ouro
tokens.usage: Altar gold, lighter. Rosary beads, rules, frames. Never text.

tokens.name: sobre-ouro
tokens.usage: Text on a gold fill (6.9:1 / 9.6:1).

tokens.name: ouro-texto
tokens.usage: Gold when it has to be text (eyebrows). 5:1 / 10:1.

tokens.name: ouro-suave
tokens.usage: Background of feast notices and solemn dates; text on it is `texto` or `ouro-texto`.

tokens.name: terracota
tokens.usage: Franciscan habit. Franciscan content; fine as text (4.9:1 / 7.9:1).

tokens.name: terracota-suave
tokens.usage: Background of Franciscan cards and bands.

tokens.name: verde
tokens.usage: Green marble of the columns. Confirmations, 'open now', social action.

tokens.name: alerta
tokens.usage: State only: form errors, schedule-change notices.

tokens.name: foco
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px gap on the background, then 2px Marian.

tokens.name: liturgico-verde
tokens.usage: Ordinary Time. Used only in the liturgical colour badge.

tokens.name: liturgico-roxo
tokens.usage: Advent and Lent.

tokens.name: liturgico-branco
tokens.usage: Easter, Christmas, feasts of Our Lady (always with a gold outline).

tokens.name: liturgico-vermelho
tokens.usage: Pentecost, Passion, martyrs.

tokens.name: liturgico-rosa
tokens.usage: Gaudete and Laetare.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero title on desktop (≥1024px). On phones, use titulo-1.

styles.name: display-italico
styles.usage: Second line of the title, in italic: the roman + italic pair of the posts.

styles.name: titulo-italico
styles.usage: Name of a feast or saint inside cards.

styles.name: corpo-grande
styles.sample: A comunidade se reúne todos os domingos.
styles.usage: Opening text of a page. Meant for older readers.

styles.name: corpo
styles.usage: Running text. Never below 16px on phones.

styles.name: sobrelinha
styles.usage: Spaced capitals above titles, as in the posts. Always uppercase.

tokens.name: espaco-1
tokens.usage: Between icon and text.

tokens.name: espaco-2
tokens.usage: Between badges, inside small buttons.

tokens.name: espaco-3
tokens.usage: Between rows of a schedule list.

tokens.name: espaco-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on phones; page side margin on phones.

tokens.name: espaco-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop; grid gap.

tokens.name: espaco-8
tokens.usage: Page side margin on desktop.

tokens.name: espaco-12
tokens.usage: Between sections on phones.

tokens.name: espaco-16
tokens.usage: Between sections on desktop.

tokens.name: raio-p
tokens.usage: Badges, fields.

tokens.name: raio-m
tokens.usage: Buttons and cards.

tokens.name: raio-g
tokens.usage: Large cards, highlight bands.

tokens.name: raio-arco
tokens.usage: Top corners ONLY: the arch of the facade's windows (photo frames, date block, hero arch).

tokens.name: sombra-card
tokens.usage: Cards on a background. Barely visible: separates by tone, not by shadow.

tokens.name: bp-celular
tokens.usage: Base: everything is designed for 360px first.

tokens.name: bp-tablet
tokens.usage: Grids go from 1 to 2 columns.

tokens.name: bp-desktop
tokens.usage: Full menu appears; 3-column grids; two-column hero.

tokens.name: bp-largo
tokens.usage: Only the container stops growing.

tokens.name: container-max
tokens.usage: Maximum content width.

tokens.name: medida-texto
tokens.usage: Maximum paragraph width.

tokens.name: toque-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of any touch target.
